description: An entirely original fictional English-speaking woodland creature called Orro. A very deep warm male voice with rounded chest resonance, a soft woody grain and a faint airy edge, clearly intelligible. Unhurried courteous phrasing, gently careful consonants and lightly rural English vowels. His enormous size is audible in the resonance, while kindness and shy humour remain close and humanly readable. Natural speech rather than a theatrical growl. Keep a stable vocal identity across whispering, laughter and fear. No imitation of any real person.
quote_evidence: Operator-chosen USD 0.25 local allocation per original voice; NOT a fixed provider quote or billing cap. Verified 2026-10-22: Gemini Developer pricing https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing#gemini-3.8-flash-tts is USD0.50/M input text and USD9/M output audio through 2026-12-31; official voice-design pricing https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/models/text-to-speech/voice-design#pricing describes text plus generated preview audio billing and illustrative 220-input/1100-output-token creation (about USD0.01001). https://ai.google.dev/api/voices documents returned usage. Allocation includes a substantial safety margin; preserve actual usage and do not claim a guaranteed maximum.
